$note: Fire reorientation, 2026-10-05 (ELEMENTS_PLAN.md §5, DECISIONS #6): 100 card names (48 Abjuration = the Forge, 44 Divination = the Lamp, 8 Evocation lightning-out + Reckoning freed), Element = Fire on every school card, and a flavor line per school card. Mechanics untouched. Apply with: npm run retext -- packages/cards/data/rewrites/2026-10-05-fire-pass.json && npm run import-cards

flavors.EVO-001: Every blaze that ever ate a city began as something this small.
flavors.EVO-002: Thrown, not aimed. Aiming is for people with time.
flavors.EVO-003: The rune is spoken into the palm. The palm remembers it for days.
flavors.EVO-004: One syllable, and the reagent in their hand is ash.
flavors.EVO-005: Cinder says the trick is not more fire. It is less patience.
flavors.EVO-006: What burned once will burn again, if you ask it nicely.
flavors.EVO-007: Feed it anything. It is not particular.
flavors.EVO-008: The rune bites the caster first. That is how you know it is loaded.
flavors.EVO-009: Dry wood, a breath, and the lesson arrives on its own.
flavors.EVO-010: A flick of ember at the ward, a flick at the wizard. Both notice.
flavors.EVO-011: A line of fire with a point on it.
flavors.EVO-012: Spoken too quickly to be answered.
flavors.EVO-013: Open the door to cast, and the room comes out to meet you.
flavors.EVO-014: Turn the blow aside if you like. The heat goes where it pleases.
flavors.EVO-015: Reagents are flammable. Cinder considers this their best quality.
flavors.EVO-016: Interrupt her and she stops being polite.
flavors.EVO-017: The oldest argument in the duel circle, and still the loudest.
flavors.EVO-018: Hot enough that there is nothing left to insulate against.
flavors.EVO-019: It does not finish when the spell does.
flavors.EVO-020: Pointed at the wizard. The ward only gets what spills.
flavors.EVO-021: Everything in the hand, all at once, and no regrets until later.
flavors.EVO-022: Fire does not keep a schedule. Now neither does theirs.
flavors.EVO-023: The flame rides your breath for a round. It takes a toll each morning.
flavors.EVO-024: A proper tantrum, with something learned from it.
flavors.EVO-025: Every component they laid out is a wick waiting to be lit.
flavors.EVO-026: Loud enough that answering costs them something.
flavors.EVO-027: The moment a smoldering room becomes a burning one.
flavors.EVO-028: The more they loaded onto the spell, the more there is to burn.
flavors.EVO-029: Reagents catch. The spell they were feeding goes with them.
flavors.EVO-030: She does not stop your spell. She simply answers it.
flavors.EVO-031: Reacting is a kind of breathing. Breathing feeds fire.
flavors.EVO-032: The Late Sun throws something down. Nobody asks why.
flavors.EVO-033: It finds the wizard first, then everything they built.
flavors.EVO-034: The hand is fuel. Cinder has never thought of it any other way.
flavors.EVO-035: Some fires cannot be argued with.
flavors.EVO-036: Each ember remembers it was once a bonfire, and tries to be one again.
flavors.EVO-037: Every answer they gave the fire, the fire took personally.
flavors.EVO-038: Burn the ground, then read what grows in it.
flavors.EVO-039: Take the burn yourself. It is the only way to be sure it is hot enough.
flavors.EVO-040: The ward does not melt. It simply has nowhere to put the light.
flavors.EVO-041: Drawn on the floor of the circle. It listens for Reactions.
flavors.EVO-042: The bigger the spell they speak, the bigger the room it burns in.
flavors.EVO-043: What reaches her comes back doubled and still glowing.
flavors.EVO-044: Grandmother lights her pipe. The rest of the circle lights itself.
flavors.EVO-045: There is no ward for this. There is barely a word for it.
flavors.EVO-046: Fire that rises is fire that has decided not to stop.
flavors.EVO-047: Hit her once and she will show you what you meant, three times over.
flavors.ABJ-001: Steel is not strong until it has been through the fire and out again.
flavors.ABJ-002: A thin shell of cooled slag. When it cracks, it tells you something.
flavors.ABJ-003: Every ward grows a little hotter, and one breath escapes toward the foe.
flavors.ABJ-004: Small spells lose their aim in the air above a furnace.
flavors.ABJ-005: A cloak of cold ash. It takes the edge off anything that lands.
flavors.ABJ-006: Rake the coals over and the flame has less to feed on.
flavors.ABJ-007: Kiln brick turns heat. It turns more when the kiln is standing.
flavors.ABJ-008: Open the flue, let the heat out, and look at what the draft brings in.
flavors.ABJ-009: A mesh over the chimney. What they throw on comes straight back.
flavors.ABJ-010: Pressed hot against the page. The spell cannot be spoken past the mark.
flavors.ABJ-011: Berenice takes the whole blast in and keeps half of it as warmth.
flavors.ABJ-012: Touch the wall and the wall touches back.
flavors.ABJ-013: Pull the fuel from under the spell and watch it gutter.
flavors.ABJ-014: Pinched out between finger and thumb, with the other hand already moving.
flavors.ABJ-015: A spell is only as whole as the ingredients it stands on.
flavors.ABJ-016: The gesture half-formed, the fingers already blistering.
flavors.ABJ-017: Nothing can be heard over a forge at full heat. Nothing can be answered.
flavors.ABJ-018: The air is too thick to react in.
flavors.ABJ-019: A squat ward of fired clay. Small things do not get past it.
flavors.ABJ-020: Lit on the wall. When the enemy moves, it tells you first.
flavors.ABJ-021: Break the crust to save the metal underneath.
flavors.ABJ-022: The oldest fire in the house. It has never once gone out.
flavors.ABJ-023: The spell dies on the tongue, and nothing lights behind it.
flavors.ABJ-024: The creature that lives in the forge and thinks of fire as a bath.
flavors.ABJ-025: Back into the fire, out again stronger. Every ward on the wall.
flavors.ABJ-026: Everything they piled onto the spell goes under the hammer with it.
flavors.ABJ-027: Break the coal and there is still a live ember inside it.
flavors.ABJ-028: Kick the fire apart and nothing on it stays lit.
flavors.ABJ-029: While it stands, nothing of theirs reaches the wards behind it.
flavors.ABJ-030: Sealed with a bead of molten iron. Not this round.
flavors.ABJ-031: Open the furnace and the melt goes where you point it.
flavors.ABJ-032: Every blow the forge turned aside, it kept as heat. This is the heat.
flavors.ABJ-033: Each Reaction was a stroke on the anvil. Here is what was made.
flavors.ABJ-034: The circle is a kiln. Every answer they give costs them skin.
flavors.ABJ-035: Hot from the forge. Hotter if the kiln is lit.
flavors.ABJ-036: Every ward on the wall, poured out at once.
flavors.ABJ-037: Strike the anvil and the anvil strikes back harder.
flavors.ABJ-038: Built for walls. Finds them, and is glad.
flavors.ABJ-039: The one metal magic will not touch. For a round, she is made of it.
flavors.ABJ-040: Berenice's epithet, earned. Nothing has ever gone through.
flavors.ABJ-041: Everything on the stack hisses out at once, and the circle goes quiet.
flavors.ABJ-042: Every point of her that still stands, delivered as heat.
flavors.ABJ-043: A kiln fired for rounds on end. Open it and see what it made.
flavors.ABJ-044: Their whole stack, dropped in the water trough together.
flavors.ABJ-045: Every ward on the circle, hers and theirs, broken for the heat inside.
flavors.ABJ-046: Heat set aside earlier, raked back into a wall.
flavors.ABJ-047: She spends banked heat to end the argument.
flavors.ABJ-048: Heat saved from old blows, spent now on the body that took them.
flavors.DIV-001: Two more pages, read by a flame that knows what is on them.
flavors.DIV-002: The flame leans toward what comes next, and away from what hurts.
flavors.DIV-003: Trim the flame, read what the smoke left, and burn a little less.
flavors.DIV-004: The lamp shows their largest ward already as a drift of ash.
flavors.DIV-005: You smell what is coming before you see it.
flavors.DIV-006: Whatever burned, something of it is still in the pan.
flavors.DIV-007: Find the weakest ward and hold the candle to the join.
flavors.DIV-008: Read their hand by candle, and let one page catch.
flavors.DIV-009: Heat a ward unevenly and it splits along its own flaw.
flavors.DIV-010: A single flame, a single card, and a choice of what stays on top.
flavors.DIV-011: Hold the lantern up. It hurts their eyes and shows you their hand.
flavors.DIV-012: The smoke makes a shape. In two turns, the shape arrives.
flavors.DIV-014: The flame jumps when they cast. The seer reads the jump.
flavors.DIV-015: The pan still holds what you need. Two pieces of it.
flavors.DIV-016: The one component you wanted comes to the light on its own.
flavors.DIV-017: Their hand, open on the table, and a page of your own turned.
flavors.DIV-018: Give the lamp what you do not need. It returns the same weight in light.
flavors.DIV-019: Hold the flame to the ward until it goes, and read the ash after.
flavors.DIV-020: A cord lit now, burning down toward a thing that is already decided.
flavors.DIV-021: Two pages by tallow light, and one set back for the morning.
flavors.DIV-022: Five curls of smoke, and the seer orders them as they please.
flavors.DIV-023: The candle is nearly out. Next turn, it finishes.
flavors.DIV-024: Take one piece from under the spell and see if it still stands.
flavors.DIV-025: Every spell they speak throws sparks. Each spark is a page.
flavors.DIV-026: The lamp shows them their own spell, and the spell believes it.
flavors.DIV-027: A spell already cast still glows. Warm it and cast it again.
flavors.DIV-028: Rake the whole ash pan back into the lamp and read on.
flavors.DIV-029: Hold the lamp to the deck and the card you need is already lit.
flavors.DIV-030: Five embers, two of them worth keeping.
flavors.DIV-031: Their hand, the top of their deck, and nothing left in shadow.
flavors.DIV-032: Stacked now. Lit in three turns. The seer has already seen the smoke.
flavors.DIV-033: Two components from the deck, before the fire needs them.
flavors.DIV-034: Sit by it until the hand is full.
flavors.DIV-035: A damp cloth over the spell, and it sleeps sealed until the round ends.
flavors.DIV-036: The match was never struck. The components were never spent.
flavors.DIV-037: A spell lit once, on either side of the circle, can be lit from again.
flavors.DIV-038: Too much oil and the lamp spits. Every spare page is a burn.
flavors.DIV-039: Read their hand, choose a page, and hold it to the flame.
flavors.DIV-040: For one turn the seer sees everything, and nothing can put the lamp out.
flavors.DIV-041: Every component that ever burned, back in the hand at once.
flavors.DIV-042: Walk the deck with a taper and light the three you came for.
flavors.DIV-043: Nine turns of damage in three. The lamp goes out when it lands.
flavors.DIV-044: Both hands, both ash pans, back into the lamps. Everyone starts again.
flavors.DIV-045: Any spell cast this round, lit again from the same flame, and one more besides.
